biomarkers.name: PRKD1 E710D hotspot mutation
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic; supports polymorphous adenocarcinoma and helps distinguish classic polymorphous adenocarcinoma from adenoid cystic carcinoma

biomarkers.name: PRKD1/PRKD2/PRKD3 rearrangements
biomarkers.prevalence: Enriched in cribriform adenocarcinoma / cribriform variant; uncommon in classic PRKD1 E710D-mutant tumours
biomarkers.clinical_use: Diagnostic; recurrent PRKD-family rearrangements support the cribriform adenocarcinoma/polymorphous adenocarcinoma spectrum

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Multiple architectural patterns within same tumour — solid, papillary, cribriform, ductal, streaming
variants: cribriform variant (formerly cribriform adenocarcinoma of tongue/minor salivary glands)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Low-grade behaviour typical; cribriform adenocarcinoma/cribriform variant can show greater propensity for regional nodal metastasis, but polymorphous adenocarcinoma is generally regarded as low-grade

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Likely salivary gland ductal reserve/intercalated duct-type cells; exact cell of origin remains uncertain
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Polymorphous — recapitulates multiple architectural growth patterns (ductal, papillary, cribriform, streaming)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: PRKD pathway activation, most commonly by PRKD1 E710D and less often by PRKD-family rearrangements, is a hallmark molecular feature associated with the characteristic polymorphous architecture
